calls.title: Team Permissions Flow
calls.summary: The meeting introduced a new metric ownership model where specific teams manage metrics, limiting edit permissions to team members and reducing reliance on global admins. This model addresses issues faced by companies like Dropbox and Square, which struggled with excessive official metrics and bottlenecks in editing. The distinction between team official metrics and org-wide official metrics was clarified, with team metrics not requiring approval flows, while org-wide metrics do. Updates to the permission system will ensure it recognizes team memberships for accurate edit permissions. An admin override permission was proposed to allow full editing capabilities for admins, addressing API key limitations. The foundation was laid for future approval flows while prioritizing a simplified approach to enhance usability and reduce complexity in metric management.
calls.keywords: Team Permissions, Official Metrics, Approval Flows, Manage Official Resources, Team Ownership, Permission Scoping
